text:
Maria D.: Follow-up from today's postmortem on missing spans + aggregation drift. Root cause summary: an accidental duplicate ingestion path combined with a serializer migration that dropped a span tag. We captured the full timeline in the postmortem doc. Below are the concrete action items and proposed owners/ETAs. Please ack and adjust if needed.

Maria D.: Actions: 1) Implement dedupe/idempotency in the aggregator + add regression test (owner: Devon K.) ETA: EOW. 2) Controlled backfill for missing spans into rollup tables (owner: Cheng L.) ETA: 48-72h after compute approval. 3) Restore dropped tag and harden ingest schema migrations (owner: Anya P.) ETA: next deploy window (promote after canary). 4) Update alerts/runbook to detect ingest+aggregation anomalies (owner: Samir R.) ETA: 2 days. 5) Add a recurring audit for unexpected span drops and a simple hourly sampling check (owner: SRE team/sre-oncall) ETA: next sprint. 6) Postmortem checklist to close loop: reproduce, fix, backfill, validate, runbook+alerts updated (owner: everyone).

Devon K.: Ack. I'll own the aggregator change. PR WIP: added idempotency key using span_id + source_hash. Opening INF-3310. Prototype branch passing local tests; will add a regression that simulates schema drift and duplicate delivery.

Devon K.: Test snippet (pseudo):
```
// push duplicate events, ensure aggregator stores one
pushSpan({id, trace_id, tags});
pushSpan({id, trace_id, tags});
assert(aggregator.countForId(id) === 1);
```

Cheng L.: Ack. Backfill plan: dry-run on 1M rows tonight, then scale to full set in 5M streaming chunks. Need confirmation we can use spare runners tomorrow morning 06:00-12:00 PT. I'll publish estimated CPU/IO and row counts.

Maria D.: Confirmed: allocate up to 8 runners tomorrow 06:00-12:00 PT. Cheng, please post the estimated row count so finance can reserve quota.

Cheng L.: Estimated ~120M raw span rows to reconcile. Streaming chunk size 5M, expecting ~36h full run with 8 workers. Will include validation queries after each chunk.

Anya P.: Found the serializer change that dropped the tag; it's safe to hotfix. Canary deploy queued now. ops-bot, kick the canary.

ops-bot: Deploy: canary by Anya P. (deploy-2026-03-23T09:47Z) 3 status: queued.

Anya P.: Canary passed smoke tests, promoting to prod in 20m. Commit: https://git.redwood/internal/commit/7a1e4f2

Samir R.: Updating alert rules: new rule will fire when (aggregation_delta_pct > 15 AND ingest_rate_drop_pct > 8) over 5m; first state = warning, second state = page. Also adding automated digest for schema changes. Draft runbook: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/obs-aggregation-drift.md

sre-oncall: We'll pick up the recurring audit. Proposing an hourly sampling job that compares service-level span counts between raw and rollups and surfaces >1% unexpected diffs. I'll add the check and link to the runbook.

Maria D.: Please add a one-line verification checklist to each ticket so we can close the postmortem follow-up cleanly: reproduce-issue, fix-merged, backfill-complete, validation-queries, alerts-runbook-updated.

Devon K.: Added checklist to INF-3310. Will include regression test output in the PR.

Cheng L.: I'll attach dry-run logs + validation queries. Example validation query used in dry-run:
```
SELECT service, COUNT(*) as raw_spans, COALESCE(r.rollup_count,0) as rollup_spans
FROM raw_spans rs
LEFT JOIN rollups r ON rs.service = r.service
GROUP BY service;
```

Samir R.: Consolidated ETAs: Devon - EOW, Cheng - 48-72h with capacity, Anya - promoted deploy (in progress), Samir - 2d for alerts/runbook, SRE - next sprint for recurring audit. If anyone needs to shift ETA, flag here.

Anya P.: One more item: found another service still emitting old schema; opened INF-3312 to reach out to that team.

Maria D.: Thanks all. I'll host a 15m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm backfill progress and runbook changes. If blocked, ping @sre-oncall or update this thread. :thumbsup:
